name: cosmic-plan
description: COSMIC function-point estimation plan: given one requirement and the green project context, plan which modules to add or modify — each changed leaf module becomes one function with hierarchical names and estimated CFPs (consumes a green cosmic-context artifact; requires topic — one requirement per topic).

cfpPerFunc.description: Per-function average CFP budget {value, min, max}: value is the target MEAN size per function and [min, max] validates that mean across functions (rule plan/cfp-avg-band); individual functions are bounded by cfpMin/cfpMax instead

cfpMin.description: Per-function CFP floor {value, min, max}: value bounds any single estimatedCfps from below (rule plan/cfp-func-range); [min, max] validates the declared floor itself

cfpMax.description: Per-function CFP ceiling {value, min, max}: value bounds any single estimatedCfps from above — a module larger than this must be split into several module functions (rule plan/cfp-func-range); [min, max] validates the declared ceiling itself

cfpTotal.description: Total CFP budget {value, downFactor, upFactor}: totalCfps must fall inside [value*downFactor, value*upFactor] (rule plan/cfp-total-band); the tech stage never totals below its planned estimate regardless of downFactor; no default — state the budget via params, downstream stages inherit it; extractable: state it in the requirement doc and run doc_extract_params with a verbatim quote (e.g. quote: 'the expected CFPs is 70') — an unquoted budget must not be invented

cfpPerSubProc.description: Average CFP per data movement; sizing guidance carried to the downstream func/tech stages

moduleLevels.description: Depth of the module tree (1-3) as declared by the upstream cosmic-context artifact: drives l2Name/l3Name requiredness (rule plan/name-hierarchy); inherited from the context receipt

topicNo.description: Derived by the engine: requirement number extracted from the topic name via topicNoPattern (explicit values override); funcId = <topicNo>-<NN> and per-function artifacts are named <artifactPrefix>-<topicNo>-<NN>; inherited along the chain

topicNoPattern.description: Regex (first capture group, else whole match) extracting the requirement number from the topic name, e.g. topic 'KERQ-352 收藏夹' → KERQ-352; the engine injects the match as the derived param topicNo — funcId = <topicNo>-<NN> (rule plan/func-id-numbering) and per-function artifacts are named <artifactPrefix>-<topicNo>-<NN>; no match degrades gracefully (rule skips, naming falls back)
